title: Vignette 2026-11-02: the registry is one server over known repositories, some read-only

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-11-02, ruling on writes to non-default repositories (RFC-049): "We are going to need a read-only flag on repos in the registry. 
The point of the registry is to establish a single server that can handle a set of known repos. 
Some of these repos may be copies of external reference repos that we don't want to be changing. 

Later, we may look at some kind of IAM and Access control, but that is far away at the moment."
